core_obligations: Choose generating sets of the outer two modules and lifts of the second set to the middle one, and build free modules and maps forming two two-term complexes with a map between them (proof lines 17898-17920).
Apply the Hom functor into the fixed module, verify the resulting sequence of complexes is short exact, and obtain the long exact sequence by the snake lemma (proof lines 17920-17937).
proof_roadmap: Build the comparison of presentations (proof lines 17898-17920).
Apply Hom and finish with the snake lemma (proof lines 17920-17938).
difficulty_reason: The lemma produces the long exact sequence of Ext groups in the contravariant variable from a short exact sequence of modules (statement lines 17876-17896). The proof does not construct the connecting maps by hand: it builds a map between two free presentations adapted to the given sequence, applies the Hom functor into the fixed module, checks that the resulting sequence of complexes is short exact, and finishes with the snake lemma (proof lines 17898-17938). Adapting the presentations so that the comparison exists is the step that carries the construction. H2.
